objectives.text: Catch a specific exception and order catch blocks from most to least specific
Predict when a finally block runs

minutes.basis: Measured in the exceptions-and-logging module PR on the authored artifact.html with the frozen authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py (sha256 0deca96bf5e367aeae51a82abdbd4b6ce0d0289ecc9868c9eff3701016edf96f): modeledP50 9.06 (902 words, 27 code lines, interactions {"confidence": 2, "drag": 1, "explore": 1, "mcq": 1, "predict": 1}). modeledWorstPath 13.81 = P50 plus the worst required route per interactive unit: predict +0.25 min (reading every option's explanation); the Java editor unit +1.5 min (a run that still fails with "has already been caught" and a run that leaves ArithmeticException uncaught before all three inputs match); each lane-sort item +0.25 min (two wrong tries, then the revealed explanation, 6 item(s)); the apply check +1.5 min (two wrong graded attempts, reading the retry representation and both feedback sets). Budget and aboutLabel are ceil(max(P50, worst path)) under the new-course rule in authoring/docs/tools/validators.md, never below the intake value 10.
